description: A Java class representing a generic credential implementation for authentication, including properties like type, secrets, and additional custom properties, extending a common credential superclass.

classes.name: GenericCredential
classes.description: A class that models generic credentials with a type, secrets, and support for additional arbitrary properties, used within a credential management system.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the credential type name, indicating the authentication mechanism for devices.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the current credential type name.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Returns the list of secrets associated with this credential.

methods.name: setSecrets
methods.description: Sets the list of secrets; throws IllegalArgumentException if the list is empty.

methods.name: setAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Sets the map of additional properties for this credential.

calls: throw new IllegalArgumentException("Secrets cannot be empty")
